issue_context.title: `fieldType` has collation but without charset information
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

the collation must have charset information, such as `utf8mb4_bin` -> `utf8mb4`, but in `fieldType`, it only set collation.

review_comments: the collate size is equivalent, but we now change `Charset` from `nil` to `DefaultCharset` and update tests correspondingly. Can you elaborate the background and how it won't affect caller assumption or user facing behavior?
